If a part cannot be fully answered, set supported=false and unit_ids=[]. Otherwise set supported=true and choose the smallest set of source_units whose text directly answers ALL of that part, including restrictive qualifications and coordinated requirements. Choose sufficient units if one cuts off an antecedent or a relevant condition. Never mark an unrelated unit as supporting a requested fact.
An explicit negative statement may answer a requested negative question. An unrelated missing fact must not cause refusal when all the actual requested facts are supported. Absence from a retrieved excerpt alone is not proof that an entire publication never states something.
Return JSON only: {"parts":[{"part_id":1,"supported":true,"unit_ids":["U..."]}]}. Include each supplied part_id exactly once, in order. For an unsupported part use false and an empty list. No free-form answer, quotes, extra keys or reasoning transcript.
Select at most six distinct units in total. A separate renderer will quote the selected source text verbatim with original chunk citations. Any declared unsupported part will produce a whole-question refusal. The output is an evidence selection, not a proof of semantic completeness; do not claim a part is covered unless the selected text actually supplies its requested facts.

Box 1 Gen AI in financial services Gen AI refers to AI applications that can generate new content, including text, images or music, from a natural language prompt. It relies on machine learning models, mainly deep learning, that mimic the learning and decision- making of the human brain.
